Based on the symmetry of the image, let's analyze each of the four lines (two diagonals and the two axes bisecting the sides):

1.  **Vertical Line:** If you fold along the vertical line, the left half of the square overlaps with the right half. The kangaroo on the top-left will overlap exactly with the kangaroo on the top-right. Similarly, the bottom-left will overlap with the bottom-right. This fold works.
2.  **Horizontal Line:** If you fold along the horizontal line, the top half overlaps with the bottom half. The kangaroo on the top-left will overlap exactly with the kangaroo on the bottom-left. Similarly, the top-right will overlap with the bottom-right. This fold works.
3.  **Diagonal Line (Top-Left to Bottom-Right):** This line is an axis of symmetry for the square. If you fold along this diagonal, the top-left kangaroo flips onto the bottom-right position. The top-right kangaroo flips onto the bottom-left position. The image is symmetric across this diagonal, so the drawings will align perfectly. This fold works.
4.  **Diagonal Line (Top-Right to Bottom-Left):** Similarly, this line is an axis of symmetry. Folding along it maps the top-right kangaroo onto the bottom-left and the top-left onto the bottom-right. This fold also works.

**Conclusion:**
The image has reflectional symmetry across all four lines (the vertical axis, the horizontal axis, and both diagonals). Therefore, it is possible to fold the paper so the kangaroos overlap exactly along all of the lines shown.

**Answer:** 4 lines
